title: NK6414 BGT corn (NK6414): Yield, Maturity and Characteristics
metaTitle: NK6414 BGT corn: Yield, Maturity and Characteristics
metaDescription: NK6414 BGT corn is a yellow GM hybrid corn variety for Luzon and Mindanao. About 105 days to harvest, 11.7 t/ha in trials. See its ratings and traits.
excerpt: NK6414 BGT corn is a yellow GM hybrid corn variety, also sold or known as NK6414 or NK6414BtGT. It was registered with the National Seed Industry Council (NSIC) in 2021 as NSIC 2021 GMCn 79. Syngenta Crop Protection AG bred it. It takes about 105 days from planting to the harvest of dry grain, with 11.73 tonnes per hectare on average in the trials.

blocks.text: If you came here looking for NK6414 or NK6414BtGT, this is the same corn. The facts below come from the NSIC registry kept by the Bureau of Plant Industry, with notes from its seller and farm sources. Compare it with the others in our [corn variety finder](/crop-varieties/corn), or see [every crop variety](/crop-varieties) we list. For the crop itself, read our guide: [Pagtatanim ng mais, step by step](/crops/pagtatanim-ng-mais).

blocks.text: Key facts about NK6414 BGT corn

blocks.caption: From the NSIC registry and its seller

blocks.text: How long does it take, and how much does it yield?

NK6414 BGT corn takes about 105 days from planting to the harvest of dry grain. That is about the average of the 89 yellow GM hybrid corn varieties with a day count, 105.4 days. A shorter crop frees the field sooner and dodges more of the weather, while a longer one often fills more.

Its average yield of 11.73 t/ha beats the average of its group, 8.13. It sits in the top quarter of its group. One tonne of shelled corn fills about 20 sacks of 50 kilograms. Trial yields come from well managed plots, so your own will depend on water, fertilizer, pests and timing. Its seller gives 105 to 110 days after planting, about 105 (wet season) in NSIC trials.

Once you know the day count, anee.io dates every task from each lot's own planting day, with [the growth stages and weather](/features/growth-stages-and-weather) beside it.
Is it resistant to pests and diseases?

blocks.caption: Reactions in the registry trials, rated under natural field conditions

blocks.text: It showed no weak spot in the ratings on record. Still, a resistant variety can break down when a new strain or pest population comes, so keep scouting. Read up on [Asian corn borer](/pests/asian-corn-borer).

The pests and diseases that hit corn fields most often: [Asian corn borer](/pests/asian-corn-borer), [banded leaf and sheath blight](/diseases/banded-leaf-and-sheath-blight), [Corn downy mildew](/diseases/corn-downy-mildew), [Corn ear rot](/diseases/corn-ear-rot), [Corn earworm](/pests/corn-earworm). Our [pest finder](/pests) and [disease finder](/diseases) help you name what you see.
Its ears grew about 17 cm long in the trials. The shelling recovery was 78.78 percent, the share of the ear weight that comes off as grain. A higher share means more grain from every sack of ears.
What its seller and farm sources say

items: **Yield:** Potential 15 t/ha (company claim), 12.7 t/ha at the 2017 Region 2 derby, NSIC trials averaged 11.73 t/ha.

**Traits in the seed:** BGT stack Bt11 x TC1507 x GA21: built in protection against corn borer and other caterpillars plus glyphosate tolerance. Syngenta also lists an NK6414 VIP (fall armyworm) version.
Made for dense planting, about 80,000 plants/ha.
Erect leaves and low ear placement.

blocks.text: Why farmers know it: second at the 2017 Region 2 derby (12.7 t/ha, BusinessWorld), on the City of Ilagan's list of common hybrids, a Mindoro farmer won a yield contest with it. These are the seller's own figures, from its own trials. So plant a small area first, and compare it with your usual corn on the same ground.
Where and when to plant NK6414 BGT corn

The registry recommends it for Luzon and Mindanao. Start with the color your buyer pays for: yellow corn goes to feed mills, while white and glutinous corn go to the table. Next, pick between a hybrid, which yields more but needs new seed every season, and an open pollinated variety, whose seed you can save. Then match the island group in its recommendation, because trials in Luzon and Mindanao give different winners. Before planting, get the field ready with our guide: [Land preparation for corn](/land-preparation/corn-land-preparation).

items.q: Is NK6414 the same as NK6414 BGT?
items.a: Yes. NK6414 is another name for NK6414 BGT, registered as NSIC 2021 GMCn 79. Seed sellers use both, so ask for either one.

items.q: How long does it take to harvest?
items.a: It takes about 105 days from planting to the harvest of dry grain. Then the weather and your care decide the exact day.
The record shows 11.73 tonnes per hectare on average in the trials. Your own yield depends on the soil, water, fertilizer and pests on your farm.
No. It is a hybrid, so seed saved from it does not grow true and yields less. Buy new seed each season.
The registry recommends it for Luzon and Mindanao. Ask your municipal agriculturist how it has done in your town.

items.q: Where can I buy seed of NK6414 BGT?
items.a: Ask an accredited seed dealer in your province, the seller named on this page or your municipal agriculturist. Look for the certified seed tag or a sealed pack before you pay.
